XIAO 1 - Instructions
content:
- Set CO₂ sensor outdoors in calm, shady location away from people or other co2 sources.
- Change settings if desired then press 'Start FRC' button to start 10 min. countdown.
- NOTE: Sensor readings take several minutes to stablize after FRC.

name: Temp Offset Input
label: Temp Offset (°F)
tooltip: Enter degrees °F your sensor reads TOO HIGH. SCD41 subtracts this amount. Always positive (0 = no offset).

name: Save Temp Offset
func:
flow.set('cal_temp_f', msg.payload);
return null;

name: Altitude Input
label: Altitude (feet)
tooltip: Longmont CO ≈ 5060 ft  |  Moapa NV ≈ 1560 ft

name: Save Altitude
func:

return null;
